Incident Bot: [P1][service-inference][us-west1] High rate of 503 responses from redis-proxy-1. Started 2026-03-14T19:02:24Z. Paging @ops-oncall. Links: https://incidents.redwood/internal/1803334444
Alex R: Seeing the page, I'm on it — quick triage first. How wide is it?
Ops Oncall: Grafana shows error-rate spike ~ 18:57 UTC across the pool. ~60% of requests 503 from us-west1 proxies. Rolling error budget burn.
Maria P: I'm nearing EOD; can I take comms and hand primary to whoever's starting night shift? I can handle CS pings.
Samir K: I'm up and online, I can be primary driver for the night. Samir -> primary, Maria -> comms. Alex — can you hand over?
Alex R: Yep handing to @Samir K (primary) and @Maria P (comms). Key steps in runbook: check redis-proxy logs, restart pods, escalate to failover if pool stuck. Runbook: https://redwood-runbooks/internal/redis-503
Alex R: Runbook snippet:
```bash
# check proxy errors
kubectl -n inference logs deployment/redis-proxy --tail=200
# restart proxy pods one by one
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deployment/redis-proxy
# if restart fails, trigger controlled failover (coord with SRE)
# redis-cli -h redis-master CLUSTER FAILOVER FORCE
```
Samir K: Copy. I'll collect logs and restart one pod to avoid full outage. Maria — prep comms template please.
Maria P: Grabbing the comms template now. Will prepare an initial outreach for CS + product.
Tess (SRE): ping — if restarts don't reduce errors, plan B is to shift traffic to us-east1 via routing-console. Can assist with the route change.
Samir K: Found repeated connection pool errors and FD leak patterns in proxy logs on pod-1. Starting a single-pod restart now.
Incident Bot: Deploy Bot: rollout restart started for deployment/redis-proxy in namespace inference by Samir K
Samir K: Pod came back up, error-rate dropped to ~25% — still above baseline. Scheduling restart of remaining pods in a rolling fashion.
Maria P: Drafted initial CS note: "We're investigating elevated 503 errors in us-west1 affecting inference API. We're actively mitigating and will provide an update within 15 minutes." Posting to #customers-incidents.
Alex R: I'm signing off at 19:30 PST. Samir primary, Maria comms — I'm leaving the incident doc and runbook notes. Ping me if it escalates.
Samir K: Confirmed primary. Will post updates every 5 mins. Current blast radius: subset of customers in us-west1, no data loss observed.
Maria P: Acknowledged. Flagging product-leads and support-ops for SLA heads-up.
Samir K: Rolling restarts complete. Error rate now ~5% and trending down. Keeping incident in monitoring state for 30m.
Maria P: Update sent to CS + product with mitigation steps and ETA. Using template + runbook references.
Alex R: Handoff complete — leaving notes in the incident doc. Great job team :thumbsup:
Samir K: Locking timeline and will escalate to platform if we see any rebound.
Incident Bot: Incident 1803334444 status changed: mitigated -> monitoring
